title: What Nuclear Thermal Tugs Is
definition: Nuclear Thermal Tugs: nuclear-thermal tugs moving cargo in space.
description:
Nuclear Thermal Tugs: nuclear-thermal tugs moving cargo in space. This is Future Transport & Mobility at its most ambitious — NTR engines research, tug logistics engineering and radiation zones operations converging on a single goal: making tug hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Transport & Mobility will decide propellant depots outcomes this century. Nuclear Thermal Tugs is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working tug hulls, the larger NTR engines vision stalls, and with it, the tug logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Nuclear Thermal Tugs in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Nuclear Thermal Tugs
title: Real Research Today: Nuclear Thermal Tugs
definition: Today's documented research behind Nuclear Thermal Tugs.
description:
The road to Nuclear Thermal Tugs is already being paved. Stratospheric balloons and airships (Sceye, Flying Whales) return as cargo platforms. Hyperloop test tracks (Virgin Hyperloop heritage, European pilots) probe vacuum-tube transport.

Personal rapid transit (Heathrow ULTra) and gondola transit expand in cities worldwide. Together these programs form the NTR engines foundation that Nuclear Thermal Tugs will build on — the tug logistics results, the radiation zones methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as tug logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First certified tug hulls service opens: NTR engines propulsion
title: 2032 — First certified tug hulls service opens: NTR engines propulsion

description:
First certified tug hulls service opens: NTR engines propulsion carrying paying passengers on tug logistics guideways.

What must be true first: the NTR engines results have to replicate outside the lab, tug logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and radiation zones operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed NTR engines demonstrations, tug logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting radiation zones uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Nuclear Thermal Tugs
definition: Estimates Nuclear Thermal Tugs readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Nuclear Thermal Tugs components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a tug hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Nuclear Thermal Tugs Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Nuclear Thermal Tugs operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Nuclear Thermal Tugs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 70198 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where NTR engines monitoring, tug logistics redundancy, or radiation zones maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Nuclear Thermal Tugs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Nuclear Thermal Tugs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Nuclear Thermal Tugs — nuclear-thermal tugs moving cargo in space.

Phase 1 — Prove (NTR engines): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (tug logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (radiation zones): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (propellant depots): tug hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cislunar-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
